disambiguation: Not a general code compiler; it compiles structured Markdown manuscripts into publication-ready formats.
extras: Fully offline compilation and export; no telemetry or cloud service required.
problem: Authors need a way to compile complex, structured notes into professional publishing formats without rewriting or losing the original Markdown source.
summary: Manuscript Compiler compiles structured Obsidian manuscripts into publication-ready formats like DOCX, EPUB, HTML, and XML for professional publishing workflows.
